title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 5: Reuben's lost birthright, the tribes east of the Jordan, their war with the Hagrites and their exile to Assyria.

questions.text: Why was Reuben's birthright given to the sons of Joseph?
questions.explanation: Reuben was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father's couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph.

answers.text: He sold it for a meal

questions.text: According to verse 2, from which brother came the prince?
questions.explanation: Judah prevailed above his brothers and from him came the prince, but the birthright was Joseph's.

questions.text: Who carried away Beerah, prince of the Reubenites, as a captive?
questions.explanation: Beerah, prince of the Reubenites, was carried away captive by Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria.

questions.text: In the days of Saul, the Reubenites made war with which people?
questions.explanation: In the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand.

questions.text: Where did the sons of Gad live?
questions.explanation: The sons of Gad lived beside the Reubenites, in the land of Bashan to Salecah.

answers.text: In the land of Bashan to Salecah
In the hill country of Ephraim

questions.text: According to verse 17, in the days of which king of Judah were all these listed by genealogies?
questions.explanation: They were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and of Jeroboam king of Israel.

questions.text: Why were they helped against the Hagrites?
questions.explanation: They cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

answers.text: They had more chariots and horsemen than the Hagrites
They cried to God in the battle and trusted in him
They made a treaty with the king of Assyria
They attacked the Hagrites' camp at night

questions.text: How many camels did they take from the Hagrites?
questions.explanation: They took away the livestock: fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys.

questions.text: The half-tribe of Manasseh increased from Bashan as far as which mountain?
questions.explanation: The half-tribe of Manasseh increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

questions.text: To where were the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh carried away?
questions.explanation: The God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul and of Tilgath Pilneser, kings of Assyria, and he carried them away to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan.

answers.text: Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan
Babylon, Riblah, and the land of Hamath
Egypt, Cush, and the brook of Egypt
Damascus, Hamath, and the river Euphrates
